messages:
Nina P: Morning people — thinking of starting a twice-weekly micro-challenge: 10min hill sprints + 15min core circuit before standups. low-commit, scalable. whos into trying Tue/Thu next week? :sunrise:
Omar H: Love low-commit stuff. What time you thinking? I can do 7:15am.
Nina P: 7:10am warm-up, sprints at 7:20, core around 7:35. wrap by 7:50 so folks still make standup.
Jen K: Im in for trying it once. Is it outside by the loading dock hill or at the small park?
Nina P: loading dock hill is short but steep  great for sprints. park has flatter repeats. pick your poison. :dash:
Sam T: I vote loading dock for novelty. also can bring a yoga mat for the core circuit.
Erin M: Can I join virtually for the core? will do sprints solo earlier but join on Zoom for the circuit.
Nina P: totally — well share a quick timer + moves list in the channel.
Omar H: quick poll: Tue/Thu or Mon/Wed? react with :one: for Tue/Thu, :two: for Mon/Wed
Jen K: :one:
Sam T: :one:
Erin M: :two: (travel on Thu usually)
Nina P: looks like :one: wins so Tue/Thu. Ill tag calendar-bot to create recurring events. @calendar-bot add event "Micro Hill Sprints + Core (Tue/Thu)" starting 2026-04-07 07:10 -> 07:50 recurring Tue,Thu
calendar-bot: Event created: "Micro Hill Sprints + Core (Tue/Thu)"  invites sent to Nina P, Omar H, Jen K, Sam T, Erin M
Jen K: also — low-key leaderboard? like fastest 3-run average each month? could be fun.
Omar H: keep it optional. Im not into public leaderboards but love a private PR tracker.
Sam T: I can sketch a tiny spreadsheet to track times if people want.
Erin M: can we add a mobility mini-challenge for the rest of the day? 5 min posture break prompts?
Nina P: great idea. post-work mobility thread after we test the routine. thanks everyone  see you next Tue (or Zoom for core).
